candidates.note: Current Auto Torque advert for a Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Makinen Edition at £99,995, 18,460 miles and five-speed manual, cross-posted on PistonHeads listing 20971451. Seller page shows live enquiry/reservation controls, a photo gallery and two keepers, and states one UK owner since import from Japan in 2009. The model rule requires no more than two TOTAL owners including pre-import history; Japanese ownership before 2009 is not evidenced, so ownership eligibility cannot be verified and the car must not be published. Exact gallery images were not fully visually inspected in this run.
